survey.method: centimetres from the SW corner of the diorama, x -> east, y -> north
survey.scale_rule: d_e_m = x_cm x 10, d_n_m = y_cm x 10   (1 cm diorama = 10 m ground)
survey.check: All four zones tile [0,0]-[120,60] m and every node, junction and exit falls inside its declared zone. The numbers are self-consistent; they are simply not yet measurements.
survey.why_it_matters: Dijkstra costs are real Euclidean lengths between these points, so a wrong survey gives a wrong route — the map is only as good as the numbers in it (§7.9).
